answer_1.quote: For each subject, we convert its corresponding triples into linguistically fluent natural language text passages with the help of a more advanced LLM, and finally collect more than 144k questions.
answer_1.outputs: Wikipedia‑style knowledge passages and QA pairs

answer_2.quote: Exact match (EM) is employed as the primary metric to assess whether the answers are completely identical to the ground truth. ... we also report the recall rate (R) ... ROUGE-L (R‑L) is used to evaluate the longest common subsequence between the LLMs' outputs and the ground truth.
